pipelines.name: Test

steps.name: Combine coverage and generate XML
steps.run:
uv sync
# relative_files + [tool.coverage.paths] let the 3.6/3.7 container and
# the runner data files merge into one source tree.
uv run coverage combine .coverage-sentry-*
uv run coverage xml

steps.name: Check for failures
steps.run: echo "One of the test jobs failed. You may need to re-run it." && exit 1

steps.name: Configure git
steps.run:
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Run generate-test-files.sh
steps.run:
set -e
sh scripts/generate-test-files.sh

steps.name: Create branch
steps.run:
COMMIT_TITLE="ci: 🤖 Update test matrix with new releases"
DATE=`date +%m/%d`
BRANCH_NAME="toxgen/update-`date +%m-%d`"

git checkout -B "$BRANCH_NAME"
git add --all
git commit -m "$COMMIT_TITLE"
git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "commit_title=$COMMIT_TITLE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "date=$DATE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
